description: Set the workflow status of many labels at once (draft, review, approved or rejected) WITHOUT changing their translation values. Pass the keys and the target status. Use this to mark keys as reviewed or approved as part of a review workflow. Returns the updated/created counts and any per-key failures. Writes to the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

keys.description: The label keys whose status to set (at least one).

status.description: The workflow status to apply to every listed key.

name: set_labels_status
title: Set Labels Status
